name: gum-jsx
description: Create diagrams, plots, mathematical figures, maps, and slides with Gum JSX.

interface.longDescription:
Create and revise diagrams, data plots, mathematical figures, geographic maps, and slide decks with Gum JSX. Get editable JSX source and export SVG, PNG, or PDF files.

Rendering requires an environment that can run commands and a separate Gum executable. The skill checks PATH and the current project/workspace environment, then installs a fresh standalone copy if needed, honoring explicit setup preferences and installation restrictions. It does not search Codex directories or caches. Downloads support macOS ARM64 and x64, Linux x64, and Windows x64. Standalone gum includes its runtime and rendering assets; no Bun installation is needed. Optional development/library mode uses Bun packages for project integration and source development. Installing this plugin does not install the renderer.

Linux x64 standalone rendering has been tested; macOS ARM64/x64 and Windows x64 runtime verification is pending. If your environment cannot run commands, or you decline setup, you can still get JSX source and rendering instructions.
defaultPrompt: Use Gum JSX to diagram a browser sending requests to an API server backed by a database. Export an SVG.
Use Gum JSX to plot points (1, 3), (2, 5), (3, 4), and (4, 8) as a labeled line chart. Export a PNG.
Create a three-slide Gum JSX deck explaining the Pythagorean theorem with a labeled diagram, and export it as PDF.
